create_conv_bn_layer: create a ConvBNLayer with configurable channels, filters, stride, padding, and activation
build_depthwise_separable_block: build a DepthwiseSeparable block with depthwise and pointwise convolutions and optional SE module
create_mobilenetv1_enhance_model: create a MobileNetV1Enhance model with configurable scale, input channels, and pooling type
build_se_module: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation module with channel reduction and hardsigmoid activation
run_mobilenetv1_enhance_forward: run the MobileNetV1Enhance forward pass on an input tensor to extract features
